name: Good Influence
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of good influence through godly conduct and faithful leadership. Believers are called to be the 'salt of the earth' and to let their light shine through good works, thereby glorifying God (Matthew 5:13,16). The training of children in the right way ensures lasting impact (Proverbs 22:6), while leaders must diligently care for the church purchased by Christ’s blood (Acts 20:28). Loving Christ is demonstrated by obedience to His commandments, which shapes our influence (John 14:15), and the character of those around us deeply affects our spiritual well-being (Proverbs 21:19).
